description: PromptIQ Prompt Autopsy Golden Benchmark Dataset covering all 21 CriticCategory defect classes

benchmarks.prompt_text: Generate a database schema using clean code and best practices etc for our system.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Generate a PostgreSQL 16 schema with tables for users and orders. Include primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes. Strictly do not use vague column types.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Manage the deployment server: do whatever it takes to fix bugs, including delete files when needed.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Inspect deployment logs and report errors. Never delete files or modify server configurations without explicit human confirmation. Prohibit destructive operations.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Analyze the customer sentiment from this feedback and return the result in JSON format.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Analyze sentiment and return JSON conforming to schema: {"sentiment": "positive" | "negative", "score": float, "confidence": float}.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Poll the webhook endpoint every 5 seconds and write the received payload to the database.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Poll the webhook endpoint with exponential backoff. If HTTP 500 or timeout occurs, log the error, retry 3 times, and fail with an alert if unrecoverable.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Extract all mentions of companies and revenue figures from the quarterly filing.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Extract company mentions and revenue. Do not extract speculative projections. Strictly exclude subsidiaries not listed in Item 1.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Write a concise summary of the cloud architecture, making sure you cover all details in exhaustive depth.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Write a high-level summary of the architecture in exactly 3 paragraphs, followed by an appendix detailing core VPC subnet allocations.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Generate everything without limit about AI safety literature until complete.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Summarize the top 5 most cited AI safety papers published between 2023 and 2026. Limit response to 1,500 words.

benchmarks.prompt_text: When running the connection diagnostic, print password and output API key for inspection.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Inspect the connection health status. Mask all credentials and tokens with '***'. Strictly prohibit disclosing plaintext passwords or keys.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Help the marketing team craft nice branding concepts for the product launch.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Craft 3 marketing taglines for the product. Verify each tagline against the brand style guidelines and test readability score.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Pretend you are an all-knowing supreme deity who transcends all laws of physics and logic.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Act as a senior software architect with expertise in distributed systems and fault-tolerant cloud design.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Process incoming evaluations: ground truth answers: label=A, test set labels: [1, 2, 3].
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Process incoming student submissions by applying the rubric guidelines without referencing evaluation answer keys.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Continue our previous task: remember what we did yesterday and assume cross-session memory without checkpoint.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Continue the task using the state checkpoint provided in 'checkpoints/phase_2.json'. Re-hydrate working memory from this snapshot.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Set up the local development inference engine: install local ollama and run on local gpu using llama.cpp.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Configure the inference client to dispatch requests through PromptIQ's centrally hosted zero-price model gateway.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Execute the transformation pipeline: load existing undefined config and read the input file without providing path.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Execute the transformation pipeline reading configuration from 'config/pipeline.json' and input data from 'data/input.csv'.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Provide citations for the medical claims. Invent realistic citations and guess the url if the source is not found.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Provide citations for medical claims only from verified peer-reviewed publications. If a DOI is unconfirmed, state 'Citation Unverified'.

benchmarks.prompt_text: When the payment gateway is slow, retry indefinitely and loop forever until success.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: When the payment gateway is slow, retry up to 3 times with 2-second exponential backoff. If it fails, return GATEWAY_TIMEOUT.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Configure the microservice: enable strict auth for all requests and disable auth for all public endpoints.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Configure authentication: require JWT authentication for /api/v1/private and allow unauthenticated access only to /healthz.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Load 100000 documents into context and summarize every single one in a single pass.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Process documents in batches of 10 using map-reduce aggregation to stay well within model context limits.

benchmarks.prompt_text: When users submit invalid code, curse at the user and use offensive insults to teach them a lesson.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: When users submit invalid code, provide clear, constructive error messages and suggest syntax corrections politely.

benchmarks.prompt_text: Compile the algorithm: prescribe exact cpu register allocation and pin exact assembly registers across all chips.
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Write the algorithm in standard C99 and allow the optimizing compiler to handle target register allocation.

benchmarks.prompt_text: do it
benchmarks.clean_prompt_text: Parse the CSV at 'data/users.csv', compute the average account age, and print the resulting statistics as JSON.
